title: 🚨 Be cautious!

messages.content:
Your task is to create a storyboard for an animated short film about the importance of recycling event objects.

The storyboard will be provided as plain text, with the following sections:

Title: The title of the novel.
Description: A brief summary of the story.
Characters: A list of characters, each with a `name` and a suggested `voice` (e.g., `name: Koiufeofd, voice: en_lkjfhwkjd`).
Plot: A description of the story's plot points, scene by scene. This section might include dialogue suggestions, but short.
Note: (Optional)

"Let op!" is a Dutch phrase that translates to "pay attention" or "take notice of" in English [1]. It is used to alert someone to be cautious or aware of something. It is generally considered less urgent than "pas op!" which is more of a warning to avoid immediate danger [2]. For example, "Let op oliespatten!" means "pay attention to oil splatters" [2].
